༄༅/ /gang shod du bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gang shod du bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun dkar chag bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa las// gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po la// dad ba'i yid kyis rtag tu phyag bgyi'o// de nyid mi'i gzugs su nyid sprul pa// gsang sngags chos kyi snying khu zab gter du| |sbas pa ma lus slar yang 'byin mdzad pa// pad+ma gling pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// gzhan yang snyan brgyud dgongs brgyud sgrub brgyud dang*| |shog ser tshig brgyud smon lam dbang brgyud dang*// mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma kun la phyag byas te// zab gter las byung skye bdun gyi// sha la sbyar ba'i ril bu la// phan yon phab rgyun gang bzhugs la// thog mar bya ba nyid la gleng*// de yang lho brag sman mdo'i brag nas gter ston pad+ma gling pa nyid kyis zab gter du bzhes pa bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las/ skye bdun sha'i ril bu bsgrub pa la/ de yang khams stod rngog gi sa'i cha gangs shod du dge 'dun brgya phrag dgu dang phyed bcas/ gzhan yang dad ldan pho mo dpag tu med pa bgrangs las 'das pa 'dus te/ bsgrubs pa'i ril bu la/ dad rten bzhugs pa che long tsam zhig brjod na 'di lta ste/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi phyag phreng dang na bza'/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gdung rus/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku sha/ sngags 'chang pad+ma gling pa'i gdung rus dang skye bdun ril bu/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi sku sha/ sras pad+ma dbang chen kyi sku sha/ kun skyong gling pa'i gdung rus/ bde chen gling pa'i gdung rus/ karma gling pa'i sman nag /rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi dbu skra/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms chen po'i dbu lo/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi dbu lo/ rje til+li pa'i rus rgyan/ nā ro pa'i phyag skyogs/

mar pa'i dbu skra/ mi la'i ras gos dang phyag skyogs/ sgam po pa zla 'od gzhon nu'i dbu skra/ phag mo gru pa'i phyag zhabs dang gsol ber bzhugs gdan/ chab bzed dum bu/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i dbu skra dang sku 'gag /nyer gnyis pa'i gsang chab/ bco lnga pa'i sku sha mtshal dang dbu lo/ bcu gnyis pa'i sku mtshal/ gcung gi na bza'/ rje kun dga' rin chen gyi zhal phyag dang dbu zhwa/ rje btsun rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po'i sku sha dang dbu lo/ gsang chab/ de nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ dza har pir gyi zhal tshom/ badz+ra nā tha dang ma hā nā tha gnyis kyi dbu skra/ sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi dbu lo dang gsang chab/ kong smyon 'jam dpal bzang po'i gdung rus/ sho sgom gyi phyag tsha/ zhang g.yu brag pa'i chu zhwa dang chu lham/ spyan snga thog thub pa'i na bza'/ dwags po sgom tshul gyi phya'u/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bzang po'i sku sbyar dang gaṇ+ḍi/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi phya'u/ paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti'i sku sha/ rtogs ldan dka' thub pa'i sgom thag /bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri'i gdung rus/ thang stong rgyal po'i dbu lo/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyan mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku mtshal/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo'i gsang chab/ bdag smyon sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo/ mkhan chen pa'i dbu lo/ sa skya pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen gyi dbu lo/ jo bo rje a ti sha'i snam sbyar dang phyag dpe/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na'i phyag dpe/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i gdung rus/ rgya gar phyag na'i sgom thag /mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po'i dbu lo/ gsang chab/ sku sha/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang bcas pa/ bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi dbu skra dang sman sgrub/

rten 'dus myong grol chen mo/ sgam po pa'i rten 'dus/ karma pak+ṣi'i gsang chab/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbu lo/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i gsang chab/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i sku sha/ dkon mchog yan lag gi gsang chab/ dbang phyug rdo rje'i sku mtshal/ dpal thub pa'i gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi dbu lo dang shang mtshal/ karma pa'i ril nag /dpal stag lung thang pa'i dbu zhwa/ sku yal pa'i dbu lo/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dbu skra/ rje maṅga'i mtshan can gyi dbu skra dang sku mtshal/ dpal chos dbyings rang grol gyi dbu skra/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi pad+ma rak+ta/ mkha' 'gro ma bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi gdung rus/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi pang gdan dum bu/ mkha' 'gro ma 'od 'chang ma'i gdung rus/ mkha' 'gro zhi ba bzang mo'i na bza'/ dur khrod brgyad kyi sa sna/ mchod rten rnam dag dang bya rung kha shor gyi sa/ tsā ri gsar rnying dang*/ gangs ti se'i bde mchog yab yum kyi byang sems dkar dmar/ chos 'khor lha sa/ bsam yas/ rwa sgreng sogs kyi sku 'dra khyad par can rnams kyi byin rlabs dang sa sna/ gzhan yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dad rten dpag tu med pa dang grub thob pho mo'i sku sha/ sman sna dpag tu med pa rin po che'i rigs dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid kyi skra sen sogs sbyar te/ gzhung dang mthun par ril bu byas la/ dril bur gzhal ba'i khal gnyis dang bre bco brgyad byung ba rnams bum par blugs kha rgyan mtshan mar byas te zhag bcu gcig bar bsgrubs/ rtags ltar byung ba'i mod la slar yang dril bur gzhal ba la khal gsum bre bco brgyad byung ba rnams 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la bkyes shing longs spyad pas thams cad tshims par gyur to// de lta bu'i skye bdun tshad dang ldan par bsgrubs pa 'di nyid ltor song tsam la'ang phan yon dpag tu med pa yod de/ slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal nas// skye bdun sha las byas pa yi// ril bu lto ru gang song ba// 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun// rig drug sdug bsngal rab zhi nas// thar pa'i lam sna rab zin zhing*// thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams su// thams cad de ru skye bar 'gyur// byol song rnams kyi ltor song yang*// bde ba can du nges par skye// 'jig rten pha ma bsad pa yi// dme pho sdig can ltor song yang*// phyi ma byang chub lam sna zin// sha ril zag med 'di nyid kyi// ril bu sgrub pa sus byas pa// pad+ma nga dang skal pa mnyam// zhes dang*/

rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i zhal nas/ skye bdun sha yi ril bu las// grog ma'i rkang lag tsam zhig ni// 'gro ba gang gi ltor song ba// ngan song gnas su mi 'gro zhing*// skye ba gsum las mi 'gyang bar// pad+ma'i drung du skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ ril bu 'di ni ltor song ba tsam gyis rigs ngan bshan pa sdig po che zhig yin yang*/ bskal par bsags pa'i sdig pa'i tshogs thams cad phyir bsnyil te/ tshe gcig la bde ba can du skye nges na/ 'gro ba gzhan la smos ci dgos pa o rgyan nyid kyis gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang ril bu 'dis gdon la sogs pa las skyob cing mtshon thub/ ril bu lto ru song ba tsam gyis lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur/ ngan song gsum gyi sgo khegs/ thar pa'i lam sna zin/ dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad ngang gis 'du/ 'gro ba'i don 'grub/ byang chub kyi sems 'phel/ ci bsam pa'i don 'grub/ tshe'i bar gcod la sogs pa zhi zhing*/ mdor na tshe ring ba sogs 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba'i bar chad dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las skyob cing*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'bad rtsol mi dgos par shugs 'byung du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i dkar chag mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ gsang sngags kyi snod dang ldan pa rnams la mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang skal med log lta can/ dred po lcags rkang can/ blun po kha cig yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ chu glang rgyal gyi zla bar shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis/ rngod gangs shod du skye bdun sgrub pa bgyis pa'i dus su/ dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
